## Houdini Dark UI

Houdini has a dark UI option available through Edit > Color Settings, where you can change from Houdini Light to Houdini Dark in the user interface tab. There are also downloadable UI configuration files that can be accessed from the Edit > Colors menu option.

The UI and viewport schemes are not locked to one another, so you can set them in two different schemes—the "Edit>Color Settings>Color Scheme>Houdini Dark" does something different than the "D>Background>Color Scheme>Dark" viewport option.

## Community-Created Themes

Users have created custom dark UI themes for Houdini. Over the years, developers have put together dark schemes that multiple users have grown fond of. There are versions like "EtanFX" that combine flat themes and include recolored elements with comments for identifying different parts of the scheme.

## Comparisons to Maya and Blender

Some users have worked on editing Houdini UI colors to match up more to Softimage and Maya for consistency when modeling and selecting things. Users have attempted to edit animation curves editor colors to look more like Maya.

Based on the search results, I found information about the JetBrains IntelliJ Darcula scrollbar color configuration:

## ScrollBar Configuration in Theme JSON

In the HighContrast theme JSON file, the ScrollBar configuration includes a Mac section with thumbColor values, where ScrollBar.Mac.thumbColor is set to "#A6A6A6" and ScrollBar.thumbColor is set to "#b3b3b3".

## Key Naming Structure

ScrollBar color keys can be compound, such as ScrollBar.Mac.Transparent.thumbColor. In compound cases, the last portion describes where the color is to be applied.

## Color Format

Colors can be defined as six-digit RGB or eight-digit RGBA hexadecimal notation. For example, ScrollBar.Mac.thumbColor can use an eight-digit hexadecimal value to provide transparency, such as "FFFFFFBE".

## Related Properties

The ScrollBar configuration typically includes:
- `thumbColor` - the main scrollbar thumb color
- `thumbBorderColor` - border color of the thumb
- `hoverThumbColor` - color when hovering
- `hoverThumbBorderColor` - border color on hover
- `trackColor` and `hoverTrackColor` - track-related colors

These values can be customized in your `*.theme.json` file to create custom themes based on Darcula.

content.text:
The thumb is now a flat block with no borders, a little darker than whatever it sits on. It darkens a step while hovered and another while dragged.

**What I found:** none of the references I checked put a border on the scrollbar thumb.
- **VS Code:** a flat, translucent grey laid over the background: #797979 at 40% in dark themes. It changes to #646464 at 70% on hover and #BFBFBF at 40% while dragged.
- **IntelliJ (FlatLaf Dark):** a flat fill 15% lighter than the track, a further 10% lighter on hover and 15% lighter while pressed. The theme files also offer border keys (`thumbBorderColor`), but the dark default sets no border.
- **Houdini, Maya and Blender:** I found nothing concrete on their scrollbar colours.

**One disagreement:** in both of those dark themes the resting thumb is a little lighter than its background, not darker. On our mid-grey #444 base a darker thumb works too, so I went with your call. If you'd rather follow VS Code and IntelliJ, it's a small change to the fill.

**What changed** (`src/scrollbar.rs`):
- **Fill:** translucent black over whatever the scrollbar sits on, so it looks the same on any surface:
  - dark mode: 24% at rest, 34% hovered, 44% while dragged;
  - light mode: 14% at rest, 22% hovered, 30% while dragged.
- **Hover:** the scrollbar only redraws when the pointer moves on or off the thumb.

**Checked:**
- **Pictures:** I drew the task output's scrollbar at rest and hovered, in dark and light mode. The thumb shows as a borderless block slightly darker than its surroundings, and a step darker when hovered. I didn't picture it mid-drag.
- **Test:** checks that on a range of dark and light greys the thumb is darker than the surface (by less than a fifth of the lightness scale), and gets darker again when hovered and when dragged.
- **Everything else:** all 193 tests pass (1 ignored), the release build has no warnings, and `piton check`, `piton build check` and `piton build` pass.

**Spec:** the Scrollbar scope now describes a flat, borderless thumb that is slightly darker and darkens on hover and drag.

Sources:
- [VS Code default scrollbar colours (miscColors.ts)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/vscode/main/src/vs/platform/theme/common/colors/miscColors.ts)
- [FlatLaf Dark theme properties](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JFormDesigner/FlatLaf/main/flatlaf-core/src/main/resources/com/formdev/flatlaf/FlatDarkLaf.properties)
- [FlatLaf ScrollBar component docs](https://www.formdev.com/flatlaf/components/scrollbar/)
